about: Every line of text in Night 1: Eske's speech, other voices, sound captions and carved lines. The game (scripts/voice.gd) and tools/make_vo.py both read this file. 'text' is the English line, which the subtitles show whichever language is spoken; 'da' is the Danish line. Eske and the men can speak English (clips in vo/) or Danish (clips in vo/da/), chosen in the settings. 'tts' and 'da_tts' are what macOS `say` speaks for the placeholder clips, with pauses; 'voice' is the English `say` voice for the men in the dream and 'da_pitch' the pitch of the Danish one. 'trigger' is either 'event' (the game calls the line by id) or the name of a condition in scripts/main.gd that starts it on its own. 'valid_while' names a condition that must still hold, or the line is dropped. 'cooldown' is in seconds; -1 means once a night. Priorities: story interrupts event and idle; event interrupts idle.

lines.when: Day 1, the first time he crawls out of the tent.
lines.note: Flat and tired. He looked for the ship anyway.

lines.when: Straight after wake_bay.
lines.note: Barely voiced, to himself. A small pause between the halves.

lines.when: After wake_alone.
lines.note: Practical. The first job of the day.

lines.when: After wake_fire.
lines.note: Making himself move.

lines.when: The fire is low (under 40 s of fuel) and he is carrying nothing. At most once a minute. Dropped if the fire is fed first.
lines.note: Low and matter-of-fact, afraid underneath. Not a complaint.

variants.da: Brænde. Jeg må have mere brænde.
variants.da_tts: Brænde. [[slnc 250]] Jeg må have mere brænde.

lines.when: The first time he picks up driftwood.
lines.note: Turning the wood over in his hands. Quiet.

variants.text: Bleached like bone. It will burn.
variants.tts: Bleached like bone. [[slnc 350]] It will burn.
variants.da: Bleget som en knogle. Det vil brænde.
variants.da_tts: Bleget som en knogle. [[slnc 350]] Det vil brænde.

lines.when: He has an armful of four and reaches for more.
lines.note: Short of breath from the weight.

variants.text: No more. Not in these arms.
variants.tts: No more. [[slnc 250]] Not in these arms.
variants.da: Ikke mere. Armene kan ikke mere.
variants.da_tts: Ikke mere. [[slnc 250]] Armene kan ikke mere.

lines.when: The first time he feeds the fire.
lines.note: Coaxing it, almost tender.

variants.da: Sådan. Bliv ved med at brænde.
variants.da_tts: Sådan. [[slnc 300]] Bliv ved med at brænde.

lines.when: Out walking while the fire is down to its last 20 seconds of fuel.
lines.note: A spike of alarm, held down.

variants.da: Ilden er ved at gå ud.

lines.when: The first time he looks at the færing from close by.
lines.note: Not self-pity. A fact he has been avoiding.

variants.da: For lille til at følge efter dem.

lines.when: The first time he looks at a walrus carcass from close by.
lines.note: Bitter and quiet. He knows the feeling.

variants.text: They took the tusks and left the rest.
variants.da: De tog stødtænderne og lod resten ligge.

lines.when: The first time he cuts blubber from a carcass.
lines.note: Whispered to the dead animal as the knife goes in.

lines.when: He tries to walk into the sea.
lines.note: A step back from the edge. Fear in the breath.

variants.text: Not the water. Not that cold.
variants.tts: Not the water. [[slnc 300]] Not that cold.

lines.when: He takes a burning stick from the fire.
lines.note: Wary. He knows it is borrowed light.

variants.text: A burning stick. It won't last long.
variants.tts: A burning stick. [[slnc 300]] It won't last long.
variants.da: En brændende pind. Den holder ikke længe.
variants.da_tts: En brændende pind. [[slnc 300]] Den holder ikke længe.

lines.when: The burning stick goes out in his hand.
lines.note: A hiss of pain, then flat.

lines.when: The first gust that whites everything out while he is outside.
lines.note: Eyes shut against the snow. A sailor riding out a squall, calm by force of will.

lines.when: The mountain reveal at dusk, if he is outside. The reveal on day 1 is left silent.
lines.note: Almost a whisper. Awe and dread.

variants.da: De har været der hele tiden.

lines.when: Away from the fire and getting cold (warmth under 40%).
lines.note: Teeth close to chattering. Short breaths between the words.

lines.when: He freezes and goes down in the snow.
lines.note: Fading. The last words before he falls.

variants.da: Jeg kan ikke... mærke mine hænder.
variants.da_tts: Jeg kan ikke. [[slnc 500]] mærke mine hænder.

lines.when: He wakes in the tent after freezing.
lines.note: Confused and frightened, just woken.

variants.text: How did I get back here?

lines.when: Straight after woke_where.
lines.note: Slower. The fear arriving.

lines.when: Sleep ends because the fire is burning low.
lines.note: Groggy, then alarmed.

variants.da: Koldt. Ilden er ved at brænde ud.
variants.da_tts: Koldt. [[slnc 400]] Ilden er ved at brænde ud.

lines.when: Dusk begins.
lines.note: Looking west. Resigned.

variants.text: The light goes so quickly here.

lines.when: Dusk begins with fewer than five pieces on the woodpile.
lines.note: Counting, and knowing.

variants.text: Not enough wood. Not for the whole night.
variants.tts: Not enough wood. [[slnc 350]] Not for the whole night.
variants.da: Ikke brænde nok. Ikke til hele natten.
variants.da_tts: Ikke brænde nok. [[slnc 350]] Ikke til hele natten.

lines.when: Night falls.
lines.note: Almost nothing. A breath with words in it.

lines.when: The first time he crawls into the tent at dusk or night.
lines.note: A habit to hold on to.

variants.text: Mark the day, so I don't lose count.
variants.da: Mærk dagen, så jeg ikke mister tællingen.

lines.when: After he carves the day's line.
lines.note: Telling himself, gently, as you would a child.

variants.text: Now blow out the light, and sleep.
variants.da: Pust så lyset ud, og sov.

lines.when: Night 1 at 100 s, after the ice cries out.
lines.note: Repeating it to make it true.

variants.text: Only the ice. Only the ice.
variants.tts: Only the ice. [[slnc 600]] Only the ice.
variants.da: Det er bare isen. Bare isen.
variants.da_tts: Det er bare isen. [[slnc 600]] Bare isen.

lines.when: Something breathes against the canvas after the fire dies.
lines.note: A whisper through clenched teeth, eyes shut. Nothing outside must hear it.

lines.when: The fire goes out while he is outside.
lines.note: Rising panic, quickly swallowed.

lines.when: The flint catches and the fire lives again.
lines.note: Close to a prayer.

lines.speaker: Voices on the water
lines.when: The dream, 5 s. A crewman in the searching boat, far off.
lines.note: Shouted across black water. Searching, not yet worried.

lines.speaker: A man on the water
lines.when: The dream, 9 s.
lines.note: Louder, impatient.

lines.speaker: Voices on the water
lines.when: The dream, 13 s. A different man.
lines.note: Higher, younger, scared of the dark.

lines.speaker: A man on the water
lines.when: The dream, 20 s. The lantern is close; this is the moment to hold your breath.
lines.note: Very close now. A full-throated shout straight at the rocks where he hides.

lines.speaker: A man on the water
lines.when: The dream, 24 s.
lines.note: To the others in the boat, giving up. Then one last shout.

variants.text: He wandered off. The cold took him. Eske!
variants.tts: He wandered off. [[slnc 300]] The cold took him. [[slnc 500]] Esskeh!
variants.da: Han er faret vild. Kulden har taget ham. Eske!
variants.da_tts: Han er faret vild. [[slnc 300]] Kulden har taget ham. [[slnc 500]] Eske!

lines.speaker: The skipper
lines.when: The dream, 28.5 s. The skipper decides.
lines.note: Older, hard, final. Not cruel.

variants.text: We can't wait for the ice.
variants.da: Vi kan ikke vente på isen.

lines.speaker: Voices on the water
lines.when: The dream, 38 s. The boat is leaving.
lines.note: Far off and quiet. Almost an apology.

variants.text: Out on the black water, a lantern. Men's voices.
The lantern swings toward the shore.
The lantern turns away. Oars, fading.
The ice cries out, far out on the bay.
The ice groans, long and low, like something turning over in its sleep.
The glow on the canvas goes out.
The wind rises to a roar.

lines.when: Carved into the rune stick on night 1. Shown, never spoken.

variants.text: The ship is gone. They left me.
variants.da: Skibet er borte. De efterlod mig.
